description: Validate a FramingUI screen definition (JSON object) against the design-system contract: shell/page/section tokens, component vocabulary, props, and theme. Returns the validator report verbatim. The free scope is the editorial-tech theme + 30 components; vocabulary outside it produces LICENSE_REQUIRED errors, which must be surfaced to the user unchanged. Pass projectPath to validate against that project's FramingUI configuration (enabled packs, local recipes). Exit code 0 = valid, 1 = invalid, 2 = could not validate.

projectPath.description: Optional absolute path to the project whose FramingUI configuration (enabled packs, local recipes) the screen should be validated against.

screenJson.description: The screen definition as a JSON object (not a string).

name: framingui_validate_screen
title: Validate FramingUI screen
